extraction.name: Video-MME
extraction.description: A comprehensive, full-spectrum multi-modal evaluation benchmark for Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) in video analysis, featuring diverse video types, varying temporal durations, and multi-modal inputs (frames, subtitles, audio) with high-quality manual annotations.
extraction.creator: Chaoyou Fu, Yuhan Dai, Yongdong Luo, Lei Li, Shuhuai Ren, Renrui Zhang, Zihan Wang, Chenyu Zhou, Yunhang Shen, Mengdan Zhang, Peixian Chen, Yanwei Li, Shaohui Lin, Sirui Zhao, Ke Li, Tong Xu, Xiawu Zheng, Enhong Chen, Caifeng Shan, Ran He, Xing Sun
extraction.rai:dataCollection: The dataset construction involves three main steps: sourcing raw videos from YouTube based on a domain hierarchy, manual question-answer annotation by recruited experts, and a rigorous manual quality review process.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Text-only questions were provided to Gemini 1.5 Pro, and QA pairs that could be answered solely based on the textual questions without video content were filtered out.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Annotators thoroughly viewed the entire video and iteratively created three relevant multiple-choice questions per video, each accompanied by four candidate options.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationAnalysis: Each QA pair was examined by a different annotator to verify language clarity, answerability, logical consistency of options, and appropriateness of the correct answer. Questions were also tested against an LLM to ensure they required video context.
extraction.rai:annotatorDemographics: Annotators with strong English proficiency and extensive research experience in vision-language learning.
extraction.rai:machineAnnotationTools: Gemini 1.5 Pro (used for automated filtering/review of text-only answerability)
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: Evaluation/Testing of Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) on compositional video understanding capabilities.

name.evidence: In this paper, we introduce Video-MME , the first-ever full-spectrum, MultiModal Evaluation benchmark of MLLMs in Video analysis.
